title: Acoustic UAV Detection in Battlefield Scenarios: Handling Noise, Domain Shift, and Weak Labels
abstract: arXiv:2608.14287v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Passive acoustic sensing offers a critical, cost-efficient, and, crucially, passive alternative for detecting small unmanned aerial vehicles. However, the practical deployment of acoustic systems is discouraged by extreme environmental noise and sensor-induced domain shift caused by heterogeneous hardware. This paper addresses these challenges by introducing a robust framework optimized for real-world battlefield conditions. We propose the integration of Per-Channel Energy Normalization (PCEN) and attention-based pooling to enhance feature extraction under low signal-to-noise ratio scenarios. We further propose a domain-aware training strategy that leverages auxiliary classes and multi-microphone data to mitigate cross-domain performance degradation. Evaluated on a unique dataset of combat-zone recordings from the Ukrainian frontlines, our approach significantly outperforms existing baselines, increasing the F1 score from 55.4% to 78.6

translated_title: 战场场景中的声学无人机探测：应对噪声、域偏移与弱标签问题
translated_abstract: 被动声学感知为探测小型无人驾驶飞行器提供了一种关键、成本效益高且至关重要的被动替代方案。然而，极端环境噪声和由异构硬件引起的传感器域偏移，阻碍了声学系统的实际部署。本文通过引入一个针对真实战场条件优化的鲁棒框架来应对这些挑战。我们提出集成每通道能量归一化（PCEN）和基于注意力的池化，以增强低信噪比场景下的特征提取。我们进一步提出一种域感知训练策略，利用辅助类别和多麦克风数据来减轻跨域性能下降。在来自乌克兰前线作战区域录音的独特数据集上评估，我们的方法显著优于现有基线，将F1分数从55.4%提升至78.6%。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合PCEN和注意力池化以及域感知训练策略的鲁棒声学无人机探测框架，在真实战场噪声和硬件差异下，将F1分数从55.4%提升至78.6%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robust acoustic UAV detection framework integrating PCEN, attention-based pooling, and domain-aware training, boosting F1 score from 55.4% to 78.6% under real battlefield noise and hardware variability.
